scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:development: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env development
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:development: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env development
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
